title: Monotone 2D Integration Scheme for Mean-CVaR Optimization via Fourier-Trained Transition Kernels
summary: We present a strictly monotone, provably convergent two-dimensional (2D) integration method for multi-period mean-conditional value-at-risk (mean-CVaR) reward-risk stochastic control in models whose one-step increment law is specified via a closed-form characteristic function (CF).
